comparison.objective: Open a connector lever, insert stripped wire to the insulation boundary, and close the lever to clamp it; candidate breaks and retrieves HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part lever actuation, axial wire insertion-depth control, and latching versus coaxial mandrel insertion, bimanual hammer impact, tool withdrawal, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Lever opened, bare conductor inserted to the correct depth, then lever closed without clamping insulation versus four tangs fractured and contained without coil displacement or damage.
comparison.reason: This is a precision insertion/latching task, but it tests compliant wire seating rather than controlled fracture and post-impact fragment accounting.
